scope: Explicit full-device A40 D128 entry; default dispatch unchanged. Graph device events and complete eager API windows are retained separately.
dependency_qualification: The selected factory required the exact package versions and official FA4 source hashes before launching.
source_provenance: Frozen source manifest retained outside the repository; every published runtime source hash is byte-equal to the measured source after rebasing onto the shared helper.

fa2.name: fa2
fa2.layout_adapter: BHSD views to BSHD and back

eligibility.scale: None or finite positive FP32-normal range

arithmetic: Single input-dtype P before dS, single input-dtype dS, FP32 products/gradients/actual-output delta, separate unscaled maximum/log2 normalization, late scale.

protocol.layout: BHSD API boundary; FA receives BSHD views and returns a BHSD view, including any backend preparation
protocol.timing: warmed CUDA-graph device events; rotate backend order; no profiling during timing
protocol.precision: CuTe single-rounded P/dS, FP32 accumulation and actual-O delta; standalone FA retains its own arithmetic policy

python-m64.scope: Separate same-stack complete implementation control; compare against its own same-process FA2 baseline.

native-m128.scope: Separate same-stack complete implementation control; compare against its own same-process FA2 baseline.

qualification.directed_gate: Rounded equations with actual O; retained directed pointwise allowances and unchanged statistic thresholds.

native.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

fa2.scope: Exact selected graph symbol in actually loaded ELF. CuTe compiler SHA required unless a mapped native CUDA extension is supplied; mapped library symbol and SHA retained otherwise. Separate from latency measurements.

public_api_boundary.scope: Same-process alternating graph replay and complete eager calls; forward retains gradients.
public_api_boundary.event_scope: The eager CUDA-event interval includes launch gaps; graph replay is a separate device-path control.
